LanguageData.JJK_CompanionDescription:
Mature three-core cursed corpses develop their own relationships and routines. Choose a role and a preferred friend. Companion follows and visits; Hauler carries allowed items to storage; Rescuer takes downed colonists to available beds; Guard stays nearby. They repair themselves with real repair kits, preserving permanent core losses.

Visits last five seconds, occur at most twice a day and build trust. Company gives +3 mood for a day (+5 with trust 60 or above). Cheerful companions give more social recreation; Gentle companions bond faster; Steadfast companions recover from grief sooner. Loss of a friend or core causes grief and a preference for company. Losing the construct gives its friend a three-day mourning thought.

Manual move/hold orders and standby take priority. Selecting a role releases a manual hold. These routines are gameplay adaptations; companions retain their existing construct bodies and self-sustaining cores.
LanguageData.JJK_CompanionImmature: Independent routines unlock when the three cores mature.
LanguageData.JJK_CompanionMourning: {0} is mourning {1}. Their cores remain self-sustaining, and they can form a new friendship.
LanguageData.JJK_CompanionChooseFriend: Choose a preferred friend. This starts a new bond at 20 trust and does not erase grief.
